name: Sepol

prices.note: 36 regular-price sneakers (28 marked-down products excluded). Shopify sneakers collection, sneaker models only (belts, loafers, derbies, oxfords without 'sneaker' excluded). Low: Downtown Sneaker $279; Estrella Sneaker Denim Blue $299.90; New Estrella $349.90; high: Denver Sneaker and Zen Wholecut Oxford Sneaker $409.90. Several Estrella colorways marked down, excluded.

notes: About ('Family Shoemakers Since 1971'): founder Seyfettin Polat started in a shoemaking atelier in 1952 and set up his own factory in 1971 in Istanbul, Turkey. hq_country TR rests on this.
Shipping policy: 'FREE shipping on every order — no minimum'; 'U.S. orders only at this time'; some items 'Factory Direct Shipping — 2 to 3 weeks' from the artisans.
Refund policy: 30-day window from delivery, free returns and free size exchanges for eligible US orders.
